title: Conan requirement declared as a version range
description: conanfile.txt declares a `[version range]` requirement. The declaration leaves version choice to a resolver run, so a release published after this review is taken without a new decision. This rule reads a `[version range]` requirement.
remediation: Pin the declaration to an exact version or to the narrowest range the project tests, and update it deliberately. Specifically: fix a `[version range]` requirement.
limitation: It matches a `[version range]` requirement in the parsed conanfile.txt; it cannot tell whether the package is installed, whether any published version is affected by an advisory, or whether the dependency reaches production code.
